subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should group-entry readability use a persisted inert `label` field across applicable channel plugins, or should OpenClaw keep schemas behavior-only and expose discovered names through configuration tooling?
rationale: Both approaches address the demonstrated friction, but the choice expands either the public configuration contract or the config-tooling product surface and cannot be resolved safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Add inert `label`
options.body: Approve one optional non-routing string field consistently across applicable plugin-owned schemas, types, metadata, documentation, and tests.

options.title: Improve discovered-name tooling
options.body: Keep group schemas behavior-only and show current remote names beside stable IDs in configuration and directory interfaces.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Continue requiring users and agents to maintain an external mapping from stable group IDs to recognizable names.

recommendation.title: Add inert `label`
recommendation.body: Approve one optional non-routing string field consistently across applicable plugin-owned schemas, types, metadata, documentation, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Shared group-policy history and prior issue involvement make this person the strongest available owner for the cross-channel config decision.
